==================
Delphi project unit paths
==================

program Demo;

uses
  System.SysUtils,
  Demo.Model in 'Demo.Model.pas';

{$R *.res}

begin
  WriteLn('Delphi project');
end.

---

(root
  (program
    (kProgram)
    (moduleName
      (identifier))
    (declUses
      (kUses)
      (moduleName
        (identifier)
        (kDot)
        (identifier))
      (moduleName
        (identifier)
        (kDot)
        (identifier))
      (kIn)
      (literalString))
    (pp)
    (block
      (kBegin)
      (statement
        (exprCall
          (identifier)
          (exprArgs
            (literalString))))
      (kEnd))
    (kEndDot)))

==================
Delphi package dependencies and units
==================

package DemoPackage;

{$R *.res}

requires
  rtl,
  vcl;

contains
  Demo.Model in 'Demo.Model.pas',
  Demo.Forms in 'Demo.Forms.pas';

end.

---

(root
  (package
    (kPackage)
    (moduleName
      (identifier))
    (pp)
    (declRequires
      (kRequires)
      (moduleName
        (identifier))
      (moduleName
        (identifier)))
    (declContains
      (kContains)
      (moduleName
        (identifier)
        (kDot)
        (identifier))
      (kIn)
      (literalString)
      (moduleName
        (identifier)
        (kDot)
        (identifier))
      (kIn)
      (literalString))
    (kEnd)
    (kEndDot)))
